comment: The clock and reset inputs do not use a threshold: any move away from exactly 0V counts, so a negative-going signal clocks the sequencer too. The output index order is not panel order: index 0 is the clock output at the top of the panel, and the six row outputs run down the right-hand edge from index 1. The step count knob and the CV knobs are all read straight from the parameter, so nothing is smoothed.
